title: 📢 Virginia Tech expands support for off-campus students
text:
1 days ago 📢 New support hub for Virginia Tech off‑campus students
Virginia Tech’s Dean of Students Office has expanded to include Off-Campus Student Support , giving students who live off campus one clear place to go for help.
On the Off-Campus Life at Virginia Tech page, students can find resources for emergency funds, food access, temporary housing assistance, medical transportation , and other basic needs. The idea is to make it easier for students, families, faculty, and even local apartment complexes to see what support exists and how to connect with it.
If you’re not sure where to start, the article encourages you to start with the Dean of Students Office and explore the linked services like Basic Needs and Services, CARES Program, Cook Counseling Center, First-Generation Student Success , and Student Engagement and Campus Life .
Events such as Frame Your First Day and Be A Good Neighbor Week are listed on the Gobblerconnect Events page, so students can stay plugged into campus and community life even while living off campus.
